market_pulse.note: Fell below $60,000 for the first time since July and traded near $59,300 around 11 AM ET Friday, down about 6.2% over 24 hours and 14% over seven days (CryptoTicker, citing CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap).
About $1,644 Friday morning ET, down about 7.6% and at its lowest since July, after trading near $1,723 earlier in the day (CryptoTicker; FinFly).
About $2.04 trillion, down 5.4% from a day earlier per CoinMarketCap, versus about $2.21 trillion early Friday UTC (CryptoTicker; Coin Gabbar).
About 55.8% on CoinGecko's measure early Friday UTC, with Ether at 9.57%; no later reading was available at publication (Coin Gabbar).

themes.title: Bitcoin breaks $60,000
themes.summary: Bitcoin slipped under $60,000 around 10:45 AM ET as U.S. tech stocks fell, with the Nasdaq down more than 2% and Nvidia down about 6% (CryptoTicker; 24/7 Wall St.).

themes.title: $1.33 billion liquidated
themes.summary: About $1.33 billion of leveraged positions were liquidated over 24 hours, roughly 90% of them longs, including $553 million in one hour, per CoinGlass (CryptoTicker).

themes.title: ETF outflows continue
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs had $582.3 million of net outflows on Nov. 19, a third straight day, bringing November outflows to about $3.47 billion, per Farside (CryptoTicker).

themes.title: Fed hike and Japan risk
themes.summary: Markets price a December Fed rate increase, U.S. 10-year yields are around 5%, and Bank of Japan signals of more hikes raise carry-trade concerns (Coin Gabbar).

themes.title: Extreme fear
themes.summary: The Crypto Fear and Greed Index stood at 12, in extreme fear, compared with 20 a week ago and 63 a month ago (Coin Gabbar; CryptoTicker).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin near $59,300 and Ether near $1,644, down about 6% and 8% respectively over 24 hours (CryptoTicker).

categories.name: Altcoins
categories.note: Solana fell about 7% to near $68; earlier Friday XRP was near $0.96 and BNB near $567, both lower on the day (CryptoTicker; FinFly).

categories.name: DeFi
categories.note: DeFi market cap about $56.2 billion, down 2.7% over 24 hours as of early Friday UTC (Coin Gabbar).

categories.name: Stablecoins
categories.note: Stablecoin market cap about $280.7 billion, down 0.6%, and among the steadiest categories (Coin Gabbar).

watch_list.why: Bitcoin's 24-hour low was about $59,241; the next reference level is its 12-month low of $58,566 from July 1, with about $61,400 now cited as resistance (CryptoTicker).
Spot ETFs do not trade on weekends, so price moves through Sunday will come without ETF flow data after a week of outflows (CryptoTicker).
CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said on-chain platforms such as Hyperliquid must register or partner with licensed exchanges to serve U.S. retail users (Coin Gabbar).

movers.note: Top gainer, up about 224% over 24 hours as of early Friday UTC per CoinGecko (Coin Gabbar).
